en: [ Telephone rings ] -Dunder Mifflin. This is Erin.
zh: [電話鈴響] -鄧德米夫林公司。這是艾琳。

en: He's not available right now Uh-huh. Yes. Sure.
zh: 他現在沒空。嗯哼。是的。當然。等他起床回來，

en: I'll give him the message when he gets up -- gets back [ Receiver clicks ] -Michael had chicken pot pie for lunch.
zh: 當然。等他起床回來，我再把消息轉告他 —— [聽筒咔噠一聲]—— 麥可午餐吃了雞肉派。

en: Actually, let me rephrase that Michael had an entire chicken pot pie for lunch.
zh: 實際上，讓我換個說法，邁克爾午餐吃了一個完整的雞肉餡餅。

notes.zh: let me rephrase that：讓我換個方式說
notes.example: Let me rephrase that so it makes more sense.
Actually, we're just looking around for now.

en: Let me be more specific. Michael ate an entire family-sized chicken pot pie for lunch, and then he promptly fell asleep.
zh: 讓我說得更具體一點。麥可午餐吃了一整個家庭裝雞肉餡餅，然後就立刻睡著了。

notes.example: He got home and promptly crashed on the couch.

en: So we're all trying to be very quiet so as to not wake him up before 5:00 p.m.,
zh: 所以我們都盡量保持安靜，以免在下午 5 點前吵醒他，

notes.example: Try not to wake her up—she had a long flight.

en: which actually should be in about...
zh: 實際上還有大約…

notes.example: Actually, we're just looking around for now.

en: ...10 minutes.
zh: 10 分鐘就到 5 點了。

en: Okay, I'm gonna go in there and change the computer.
zh: 好的，我要進去換台電腦。

en: Are you sure you can change his watch?
zh: 你確定你能幫他換手錶嗎？ -我能做到。

en: -I can do it. -What do you need from me?
zh: -我能做到。你需要我做什麼？

en: Normally, I don't condone leaving early, but I have an appointment with the horse doctor.
zh: 通常情況下，我不贊成提前離開，但我約了馬醫生。

en: How that horse became a doctor, I don't know.
zh: 我不知道那匹馬是怎麼成為醫生的。

en: [ Laughs ] No, I'm kidding.
zh: [笑] 不，我開玩笑的。

en: He's just a regular doctor who shoots your horse in the head when its leg is broken.
zh: 他只是個普通的醫生，馬腿斷了就會朝馬頭開槍。

en: -[ Mumbling ] [ Horn honks ]
zh: -[咕噥聲] [喇叭聲]

en: Like clockwork.
zh: 像鐘錶一樣準時。

en: [ Loud forced laughter ] Oh, no.
zh: [強顏歡笑] 哦，不。糟糕

en: -Uh-oh. What's so funny? -You had to be there.
zh: 。有什麼好笑的？你必須親身經歷才能體會。

en: -Oh, yay. Geography joke. [ Laughs ] Oh, m-- Oh, wow.
zh: 哦，太好了。地理笑話。 [笑] 哦，我的——哦，哇。好的。好的

en: Okay. All right. Let's all go home. Go on.
zh: 。我們都回家吧。繼續。

en: See you all tamale. -Good night. -See you later!
zh: 再見，各位玉米粉蒸肉。 - 晚安。再見！

en: -Good night, Michael! -Yeah! -Whoo! -Did it!
zh: 晚安，麥可！ -是的！嗚嗚嗚！做到了！

en: -[ Imitates gunfire ] -[ Imitates gunfire ]
zh: -[ 模仿槍聲 ] -[ 模仿槍聲 ]
